mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_asset (sha256, storage_key, file_type, file_size, meta_title, meta_author, ref_count, created_at) VALUES (#{sha256}, #{storageKey}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{metaTitle}, #{metaAuthor}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE file_asset SET ref_count = ref_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_asset SET ref_count = ref_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id}
